title: CrestApps Accounts configuration
description: The settings of the Accounts module read from appsettings.json, in the OrchardCore section of the host or a tenant.

EmailDomains.description: The e-mail domains accounts can't claim (the Account E-mail Domains feature).

PublicDomains.description: More public mail providers this tenant refuses, beside the built-in ones (gmail.com, outlook.com...), such as a regional provider.
